name: larsacus/DeceptiCam
description: Decepticam is a covert camera that is instantly available when launched and is activated by putting your iPhone up to your ear, as if taking a phone call.  DeceptiCam will start shooting photos at intervals or start capturing video when the proximity sensor is activated (as if taking a phone call), and ends and saves the file when the proximity sensor is no longer covered.  This app will never be approved into Apple's App Store due to the blatant mimicking of iPhone's phone interface.  _**Kind of a fun project - needs a lot of work to be truly useable.**_
